d: Chhath Puja 2026 : aaj se chhath mahaparv ki shuruaat ho chuki hai....aur dilli men rahne vale hajaron-lakhon log ab apne ghar bihar jane ki taiyari men jut gae hain....lekin tyohar ke is mauke par sabse bara saval hai ki aakhir ghar kaise pahunchen...tren men tikat ki maramari hai aur praivet bason ka kiraya bhi jeb par bhari par raha hai....lekin ab aapko pareshan hone ki jarurat nahin hai.... kyonki chhath shuru hote hi sarkar ne dilli se bihar jane vale yatriyon ke lie bara intjam kar diya hai.... 77 speshal basen sarkon par utar chuki hain to relve ne bhi 24 speshal trenen chalane ka…
